snippet.title: TEKKEN 8 – Kunimitsu Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Rin-Pyoh-Toh-Sha-Kai-Jin-Retsu-Zai... Zen!

Kunimitsu is ready to show her evolved Ninjutsu arts in #TEKKEN8 on June 1st PDT | June 2nd CEST and May 27th PDT | May 28th CEST in early access!
